checks: The same ... as matches parity of condition when returned vs when received. From and among don't license the comparative clause, than requires a comparative. Rewrite Chinese order so 如同 fits.

activeQuestion.prompt: Please return the rented equipment in the same condition ____ you received it.
activeQuestion.promptZh: 請歸還租借設備，設備的狀態應____當初收到時一樣。

options.whyZh: from 不能引導此處與原始狀態相同的比較。
among 後接多個對象，不能引導 you received it 子句。
the same ... as 是表達相同狀態的搭配。
than 用於比較級，不搭配 the same。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: the same ... as 是表達相同狀態的搭配。
activeQuestion.evidence: in the same condition as you received it
